title: THE FRAME LOOP MAKES LESS GARBAGE
why: Job 120k: the 2 player frame grew since v34.18. Two blind per frame costs the brief named are cut with the look unchanged: the auto resolution window was copied and sorted twice a frame with array sorts (five new arrays a frame), and the edge darkening gradient was rebuilt every frame. The window now sorts in two reused number buffers and the gradient is kept until the canvas size or strength changes.
now: Same picture and same auto resolution decisions, less memory churn every frame.
